VPL_v3.rule: F6 (natural, continuous cost): routed no-decision = 0, routed total realised cost < best constituent total, routed infeasible <= best constituent infeasible, one-sided exact sign test over held-out days p < 0.05, routed median latency <= 120 s. Best constituent chosen on held-out results (fewest wrong + no-decision, then lowest total). Wilcoxon and ablation comparisons reported, not part of the rule. VPL = families meeting their rule.

limits: real arrivals and real outcomes; the handle time, service target and cost weights are a declared decision layer, not the bank's
the required staffing is the Erlang C model's at the realised rate: the outcome is real, the queueing model is an assumption shared by every arm
days are consecutive weekdays from one bank in 2003; the day is the unit of the sign test but days are not independent draws from a population of call centres
one container; latency is this machine's
